input.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance and Licensee data return/deletion obligations into Article XXI (Effect of Termination).
input.comment: [Playbook] Article XXI requires us to hand everything back but says nothing about getting our own data back or moving off the platform, so we have added a transition-assistance and data-return paragraph: up to six months of assistance at Licensor's then-current rates, export of Licensee Data within 30 days in a machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter. If six months is too long, we can accept 90 days of assistance with the same 30-day export.

ops.text: (c) TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND RETURN OF LICENSEE DATA. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Licensor shall (i) at Licensee's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for a period of up to six (6) months at Licensor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days of such expiration or termination, return to Licensee all data, records and trade and account information of Licensee and its customers stored in or processed by the Licensed Technology ("Licensee Data") in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete Licensee Data from its systems and certify such deletion to Licensee in writing. This Section shall survive termination of this Agreement.
